_note: Jasper Crane at the Broken Tankard (docs/regions/harlow-bridge.md, Jasper Crane; decision 0434): already in town, as ever, at a table by the taproom's hearth, his room upstairs paid a month ahead. He buys Thadeous a cider every time and won't say why, and he leaves the room when the Lantern Man is sung (story/tankard.ts). Drafts for Matt or his writer friend.

lines.text: Jasper, at a table by the hearth, with a pot of tea nobody brought him.
You came the long way. Room's upstairs, paid a month ahead. Oren likes that in a man.
Things take as long as they take.
Jasper sets a cider down by Thadeous's elbow without a word, and goes back to his tea.
Five years he's done that. Every time I'm in. Won't say why.
Town's waiting on noon, and on the clock. I'm only waiting. What'll it be?
Clock's going again, I hear. You'd think they'd be glad. They're mostly surprised. What'll it be?
He's in good hands, then. Or yours, anyway. What'll it be?
